---
name: COSMIC DE repo notice
about: Informs COSMIC DE bug reporters of the correct repo for COSMIC DE bug reports (https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-epoch/)
---

Is this a bug report or feature request related to COSMIC DE? If it is, please go to https://github.com/pop-os/cosmic-epoch/issues instead.

If your bug report or feature request pertains to legacy COSMIC, which was the set of GNOME extensions in Pop!\_OS 22.04, feel free to delete this message and carry on with your report/request.
